#!/bin/sh
# Game: infinite Mealy
# Infinite Moore verdicts use input-delay encoding in cluster.N.mealy.
# Generated by tlsfcompose: synthesize each residual cluster with
# Spot unless cluster.N.aag was already solved in this run.
# controllers.txt holds the combinational part (already solved,
# exact).  The spec is realizable iff every cluster is.
dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
ok=1
run() {
  base=${1%.ltl}
  if [ "$5" = solved ]; then
    echo "$base.aag: SOLVED"
    return
  fi
  f=$(mktemp) || { echo 'SPEC UNKNOWN'; exit 2; }
  sed '/^c ins=/d; /^c outs=/d' "$dir/$4" > "$f" || { rm -f "$f"; echo 'SPEC UNKNOWN'; exit 2; }
  ltlsynt --ins="$2" --outs="$3" -F "$f" --realizability >/dev/null
  status=$?
  case $status in
    0) echo "$1: REALIZABLE" ;;
    1) echo "$1: UNREALIZABLE"; ok=0 ;;
    *) echo "$1: UNKNOWN (solver exit $status)"; rm -f "$f"; echo 'SPEC UNKNOWN'; exit 2 ;;
  esac
  rm -f "$f"
}
run cluster.0.ltl "/^\x63$/" "/^\x70$/" cluster.0.spot pending
if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then
  echo "SPEC REALIZABLE"
else
  echo "SPEC UNREALIZABLE"; exit 1
fi
